Bot: You are right, it would be better if we went soon. This show brought more attention than we thought.
You: Really? 
Bot: Better not risk it, right?
Lady Annalie: No idea what trouble you two are involved in, but I’m ready to go whenever you two are.
You: It’s settled then. Get ready and wait for our call.
Lady Annalie: See you at the airport, then! Bye!
